integrity: The infinite theorem is proved algebraically. The included exact-integer enumeration is a finite cross-check only; no independent priority certification is asserted.
limitations: The exact theorem applies to order-four cyclic subgroups modulo \(4q\) with q odd >1 and square \(2q-1\); it does not determine all order-four subgroup sums. The older general residue-distribution article was not available in full for priority comparison.
title: Two-level quartic residue sums modulo four times an odd integer
